rows.observation: “Cacophony”指嘈杂刺耳的声音；“心灵尖啸”增添了心灵含义。冻结输入缺少该名称的具体语境，无法确认是否为有意命名。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults timed_effects.lua:776–785 CACOPHONY 效果名与同名技能（madness.lua:180 Cacophony）对应，本库技能名为“心灵尖啸”（tome-cults.lua:2969），效果沿用同名，保持一致，保留。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文“disfigured creature”指外形受损或畸形的生物，译文“不成型的生物”改变了含义。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults zones/town-kroshkkur/npcs.lua:107–109 disfigured creature 的 desc 为 A vaguely humanoid shape，disfigured 指畸形、扭曲；现译“不成型的生物”意为无定形，与“略具人形”相悖。本库仅此一处（tome-cults.lua:4524）。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: “hemospinner”含血液与纺织之意，译文“胞递呈者”表达了不同概念；缺少该生物名称的术语或语境证据，无法确认是否为约定译名。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults general/npcs/blobs.lua:93–96 dendritic hemospinner 为血球类软泥怪命名梗；本库“树突胞递呈者”借用免疫学“树突状细胞/抗原递呈”双关，与 corrupted 变体（tome-cults.lua:561）同族一致；改名须新拟名并同步整族，记 advisory，不在本批修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文触发条件是熵能反冲施加到角色身上或已有反冲增加；译文“每当你受到熵能反冲时”遗漏了反冲增加这一条件。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults talents/demented/oblivion.lua:23–58 空无 info 源串为单行（无换行），现译在“增加（减少）”前插入 \n\t\t，一级换行不变量；另 On having entropic backlash applied or increased to you 的“或增加”被略去。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 末段原文说两名卫兵互相低声说了些什么（“murmer something to each other”），译文却说“互相默默无语”，意思相反。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:514–530 返回符文一节：the two guards murmer something to each other 意为两名卫兵互相低语，现译“互相默默无语”意思相反。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文只说 collar 不在乎角色的死亡；译文增添了“项环上的生物”，改变了指代。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:630–651 利牙项环 desc 明言项环本身是一只生物（This strange creature seems to melt around your neck），special_desc 中“项环上的生物”指称同一生物，不改变指代，保留。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文明确说在 Godfeaster 中被 Malyu 救免于死并成功逃脱；译文遗漏“救免于死”，并增添原文没有的“巨大蠕虫”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults achievements/all.lua:165 成就描述 Got saved from death in the Godfeaster by Malyu and managed to escape：现译“被马虑护送离开巨大蠕虫噬神者”丢“被救免于死”“成功逃脱”，改“护送”，并增译“巨大蠕虫”。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文“Aranion stepped out in full view”指他走到众人能看见的地方，译文写成“全神贯注地走了出来”；原文“charge towards the rest”指冲向其余骷髅，译文写成“冲向其他地方”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:707–723 追击死灵法师一节：Aranion stepped out in full view 误作“全神贯注地走了出来”；I was about to charge towards the rest（其余骷髅）误作“冲向其他地方”。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/zones/town-kroshkkur/npcs.lua:108-109 (unpinned): 'disfigured' means deformed/misshapen (畸形/扭曲), and desc says 'A vaguely humanoid shape'. 不成型 means formless/unshaped, which contradicts the vaguely humanoid form described.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults zones/town-kroshkkur/npcs.lua:107–109 disfigured creature 的 desc 为 A vaguely humanoid shape，disfigured 指畸形、扭曲；现译“不成型的生物”意为无定形，与“略具人形”相悖。本库仅此一处（tome-cults.lua:4524）。 contextual 同指“不成型”与 desc 的略具人形相悖，宿主核对属实。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/general/npcs/blobs.lua:94 (unpinned): 'hemospinner' = hemo(blood)+spinner. 递呈者 borrows the immunology term 'presenting' (as in antigen-presenting cell), which the source does not say, and drops the blood/spinning meaning entirely. Only 'dendritic' (树突) is carried over.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults general/npcs/blobs.lua:93–96 dendritic hemospinner 为血球类软泥怪命名梗；本库“树突胞递呈者”借用免疫学“树突状细胞/抗原递呈”双关，与 corrupted 变体（tome-cults.lua:561）同族一致；改名须新拟名并同步整族，记 advisory，不在本批修复。 contextual 同指 hemospinner 未译出血液/纺丝义；属命名取舍，宿主维持 advisory。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/talents/demented/oblivion.lua:58 (unpinned): the source info string is one line, but the target inserts a newline plus two literal TAB characters (\n\t\t) before 增加（减少）, so a stray line break and tabs render in the talent tooltip. The trigger 'applied or increased to you' is also shortened to 受到熵能反冲时, which drops the 'increased' (stack/extend) case.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults talents/demented/oblivion.lua:23–58 空无 info 源串为单行（无换行），现译在“增加（减少）”前插入 \n\t\t，一级换行不变量；另 On having entropic backlash applied or increased to you 的“或增加”被略去。 contextual 同指插入换行与制表符、略去“或增加”，宿主核对属实。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/lore/fay-willows.lua:528,530 (unpinned): 'Catching my breathe I explained' means recovering breath (缓过气/喘口气) but is rendered 我屏住呼吸 (held my breath), which contradicts the panting scene in line 526. 'the two guards murmer something to each other' means they whispered to each other, but is rendered 互相默默无语 (silent to each other), which is the opposite. Minor: 'I was walked through the process' (she guided me) is rendered as 我开始了激活符文的过程, which loses the guidance.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:514–530 返回符文一节：the two guards murmer something to each other 意为两名卫兵互相低语，现译“互相默默无语”意思相反。 contextual 同指“默默无语”，另指 Catching my breathe 误作“我屏住呼吸”（应为缓过气来）、I was walked through the process to activate the rune 误作“我开始了激活符文的过程”（丢“由她指导”），宿主逐句核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/achievements/all.lua:165 (unpinned): the source says the player was saved from death in the Godfeaster by Malyu and managed to escape. The target 被马虑护送离开巨大蠕虫噬神者 drops both 'saved from death' and 'managed to escape', leaving only 'escorted out', so the rescue-from-death condition is lost.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults achievements/all.lua:165 成就描述 Got saved from death in the Godfeaster by Malyu and managed to escape：现译“被马虑护送离开巨大蠕虫噬神者”丢“被救免于死”“成功逃脱”，改“护送”，并增译“巨大蠕虫”。 contextual 同指丢“被救免于死”“成功逃脱”，宿主核对属实。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/lore/fay-willows.lua:717,723 (unpinned): 'Aranion stepped out in full view' (stepped into plain sight) is rendered 全神贯注地走了出来 (walked out fully concentrating), which is a mistranslation. rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:707–723 追击死灵法师一节：Aranion stepped out in full view 误作“全神贯注地走了出来”；I was about to charge towards the rest（其余骷髅）误作“冲向其他地方”。 contextual 同指两处，另指“把我们传送帷幕的另一边”缺“到”字，宿主核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。
